package.name: aav_io_mux_rs
package.description: The sensor mux and the output mux in Rust (rclrs): the default since 17 Nov (Ben), in place of aav_io_mux's Python nodes (removed 22 Nov 2026). The same node names, topics, QoS, parameters, service and answers: /system/source in, /system/sensor_mux/state out; ego's /ego/actuator_cmd on to /control/target/actuator_cmd with its heartbeat, only while every source is the target's; /safety/output_mux/state and the clear service. A safety lock (the ESP32's heartbeat); the Python is one switch away (io_mux_impl:=python). The logic is the io-mux-core crate, with no ROS, checked step by step against the Python's answers.
